---
title: "Utviklingsanalyse"
subtitle: "KOMMUNE"

latex-tinytex: false
latex-auto-install: false

format:
  beamer:
    classoption: landscape
    lang: nb
    mainfont: apercu
    sansfont: apercu
    fontsize: 8pt
    papersize: a4
    logo: logo.png
    header-includes: |
      \usepackage[dvipsnames]{xcolor}
      \definecolor{myblue}{RGB}{0, 105, 180}

      \setbeamercolor{title}{fg=myblue}
      \setbeamercolor{subtitle}{fg=myblue}

      \setbeamerfont{title}{size=\huge}
      \setbeamerfont{subtitle}{size=\Large}

      \setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}

      \setbeamertemplate{background}{
        \includegraphics[
          width=\paperwidth,
          height=\paperheight
        ]{Folkehelse_Morgen_RGB@2x.png}
      }
---
